movies.title: Crypto Man [Hindi]
movies.description:
"You should live up to the expectations."

Struggling under the immense weight of his mother Ok-ja's expectations, Do-hyun forges residency documents to enter Seoul's prestigious Daechi-dong school district. This early taste of manipulation sparks a larger ambition: to master the very system that once denied him opportunity. When a wealthy classmate exploits disability benefits to claim a coveted exchange program slot, Do-hyun's disillusionment turns into fierce determination.

At university, he partners with Ji-woo-a like-minded entrepreneur who shares his skepticism toward conventional meritocracy-to tap into government-funded "blind money," youth entrepreneurship subsidies distributed with minimal oversight. Exploiting credits meant for socially disadvantaged groups, they deliberately engineer business failures, requalifying for fresh subsidies at every turn. Their calculated approach catches the eye of Kevin, an influential investor who bankrolls Do-hyun's most audacious venture yet: "MOMMY coin," a cryptocurrency poised to revolutionize wealth creation. As the coin's value skyrockets, Do-hyun becomes a media sensation, embodying South Korea's obsession with rapid success. Yet beneath the triumphant headlines lies a fragile foundation-his unrefined algorithm and ethically dubious practices draw scrutiny from financial regulators.

Inspired by real-life incidents, Do-hyun's story is a cautionary tale about ambition, systemic loopholes, and the moral gray areas between innovation and exploitation. When the house of cards he built begins to collapse, Do-hyun is forced to confront whether the true culprit is the broken system or the very people who exploit it.

series.description: Sung Hae Sung (Yeo Jin Goo, Circle: Two Worlds Connected) is a cheery high school student. She is now 31; he is 19. Can they pick up their love where they left off, or will their reunited worlds always stay separate? series.title: You Are My Glory [Hindi]
series.overview: A famous celebrity is about to lose her lucrative video game brand deal. Will her former crush help her become a gaming champion – and might this lead them to romance?

episodes.title: Accidental Encounter
episodes.overview: Jing Jing is the endorser of Honor of Kings, but someone posted a video of how badly she plays. As a result, she must train hard to participate in an entertainment game to prove herself. Yu Tu happens to be playing the game lately and invites Jing Jing to a group battle by mistake.

episodes.title: Contemplation
episodes.overview: Yu Tu is contemplating whether to resign from his work in the research institute. If he works in finance, he can earn four times more than he is making now, but the galaxy is what he aspires to. Meanwhile, Jing Jing devises a plan to get Yu Tu to coach her in Honor of Kings to improve her skills.

episodes.title: We Meet Again
episodes.overview: Jing Jing requests Yu Tu to be her coach but he politely refuses. With continuous training, Jing Jing gets better at the game, surprising even to her manager. Upon finding out that Yu Tu lives in the same city, Jing Jing tricks Yu Tu to go to her house and they finally meet each other.

episodes.title: Training
episodes.overview: Yu Tu finally agrees to be Jing Jing's coach. Yu Tu goes to Jing Jing's place and teaches her how to play the game. They practice all day long to find the right hero for Jing Jing.

episodes.title: A Clean Break
episodes.overview: Yu Tu meets up with Xia Qing and has a clean break with her. Then he attends a class gathering and gets mocked for his career path. Jing Jing helps him to get even.

episodes.title: The Single's Day
episodes.overview: After playing a few matches, Yu Tu picks a few heroes that he thinks are suitable for Qiao Jing Jing's skill level. Meanwhile, Xiao Zhu notices that Yu Tu has started to treat Qiao Jing Jing differently. While playing with other gamers, Yu Tu records the game to help Qiao Jing Jing learn how to analyze the game better.

episodes.title: A Night Out
episodes.overview: After Yu Tu has a somewhat awkward dinner with his friends, he asks if Jing Jing wants to go to a movie. Jing Jing picks a movie, but then realize it might make Yu Tu think of unpleasant memories. And even though they're careful, Jing Jing is still caught on camera by a fan. While Jing Jing and Yu Tu are watching a livestream at her house, Ling arrives with the makeup artists and stylists.

episodes.title: Level Up
episodes.overview: Jing Jing secures a role in a new movie and takes joy in being asked to gain a bit more weight for the role. She decides to introduce Yu Tu to Ling and brings him to Ling's house where he meets her close colleagues for the first time. She also sets a goal to level up in rank in the game.

episodes.title: The First Sight
episodes.overview: Yu Tu sees his teacher and his wife in the restaurant that he and Jing Jing is in, and he invites them to eat with them. The conversation turns sour when his resignation is mentioned, and Yu Tu gets mad at Jing Jing when she defends him. Afterwards, Yu Tu receives an urgent call to go on a business trip to fix a problem with J-X, so they don't see each other for some time.

episodes.title: Salvaging
episodes.overview: Yu Tu and Guan Zai work hard to salvage J-X satellite. As they're going back to their apartment, Guan Zai falls ill and worries about his family. Meanwhile, Yu Tu invites Qiao Jing Jing for games on Honor of Kings.

episodes.title: The Reconciliation
episodes.overview: Yu Tu returns from Xi'an and reconciles with Qiao Jing Jing. Then he takes care of Guan Zai who is admitted to the hospital. Later, when Yu Tu continues to coach Qiao Jing Jing, she finds that he has changed after the trip.

episodes.title: Making Decisions
episodes.overview: Shen Jing is having a hard time coping with Guan Zai's cancer. Yu Tu is staying by Qiao Jing Jing's side to train her, giving her good advice on who to pick for her team. Qiao Jing Jing is surprised when Yu Tu asks her what she wants for her birthday.

episodes.title: Super League
episodes.overview: The Super League begins and the players are divided into two teams of five. After training so hard under Yu Tu, Jing Jing confidently strategize with her chosen teammates. Can Jing Jing and her team win the battle against other professional gamers?

episodes.title: Second Round
episodes.overview: The second round of the competition begins. Which team will win the second round? After the competition is over, Yu Tu feels out of place.

episodes.title: Different Worlds
episodes.overview: On their way back from Super League, Qiao Jing Jing finds out that Yu Tu is going back to work at the research institute. She confesses to Yu Tu. However, he tells her that he will not be seeing her anymore.

episodes.title: Hard to Let Go
episodes.overview: After Yu Tu starts working at the institution again, he manages to lead the team to some success. However, with the original leader Guan Zai gone, his responsibilities increase. In the meantime, Yu Tu's ex-girlfriend comes to Shanghai, while Qiao Jing Jing hasn't been in touch with him.

episodes.title: Walking Down Memory Lane
episodes.overview: Yu Tu visits his parents in Yixing before going on his one-month business trip. He digs out his old computer and reads his old chats with Qiao Jing Jing, reminiscing the past. When taking a walk with his mom, they talk about the old days and his mom’s regrets of discouraging him from doing what he wanted in the past.

episodes.title: Testing
episodes.overview: Yu Tu refuses to join any group activities during the outfield trip. He reads his old chats with Qiao Jing Jing again. Guan Zai calls Yu Tu and his advice inspires Yu Tu to write Jing Jing a letter. The next day, Yu Tu sends out the letter via post.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: Jing Jing questions her ex-boyfriend's sincerity. She receives Yu Tu's letters and reads them. After her performance, she finds Yu Tu waiting to send her back to Yixing to spend the new year.

episodes.title: New Year
episodes.overview: Yu Tu confesses his feelings to Qiao Jing Jing but he is rejected by her since she thinks that he’s not sincere. He fetches her back to Yixing anyway and they spend the new year separately with their own families.

episodes.title: Forgiven
episodes.overview: When Pei Pei asks, Jing Jing doesn't want to talk about Yu Tu, yet she decides to join the class gathering because of him. Upon hearing that Jing Jing will be at the gathering, Yu Tu rushes over for her.

episodes.title: Happy Together
episodes.overview: Qiao Jing Jing and Yu Tu are officially together. Jing Jing wants to hide their relationship from their parents, but when Yu Tu's mom catches him and Jing Jing together by their house, Jing Jing comes up with lies. Yu Tu returns the favor with Jing Jing's parents before he drives her back to Shanghai.

episodes.title: Long Distance Relationship
episodes.overview: Yu Tu stays over at Jing Jing's place. Xiao Zhu and Qiu Ling are surprised to find out that they are officially together. Yu Tu and Jing Jing start their long distance relationship as Jing Jing starts filming out of town.

episodes.title: White Lies
episodes.overview: Qiao Jing Jing returns to Shanghai a day earlier due to a change in her filming schedule. Due to the traffic situation, she goes to Yu Tu's house instead. In order to get Jing Jing to stay over at his house, Yu Tu pretends to play badly at Honor of Kings to delay her.

episodes.title: The Sleepover
episodes.overview: Qiao Jing Jing spends the night at Yu Tu's house, unaware that the house is being watched. The next morning, Yu Tu follows her to a jewelry event and has to disguise himself as part of the staff. Later that night, they are ready to take the next step in their relationship.

episodes.title: Surprise Visit
episodes.overview: Jing Jing goes back to work in the desert, where she has trouble connecting to the Internet. Yu Tu visits her after completing his assignment nearby. Rushing as he has to return to Shanghai on the same day, he gets down to business immediately.

episodes.title: Staying Over
episodes.overview: Jing Jing decides to stay over at Yu Tu's place after the filming ends. She lies that she'll be leaving the next morning, but Yu Tu finds out from Qiu Ling that she's having a break for two months. Then he surprises her with a revamped room.

episodes.title: Meet My Girlfriend
episodes.overview: Guan Zai returns to work, but Yu Tu feels sad about Guan Zai withdrawing from God Finder. Jing Jing convinces him by comparing it to their relationship. Meanwhile, Yu Tu introduces Jing Jing to his colleagues during Guan Zai's welcome dinner.

episodes.title: The Proposal
episodes.overview: Chen Xue invites Jing Jing and Yu Tu over to her place for dinner. Later on, Yu Tu invites Jing Jing to watch him play in a basketball match and takes the chance to officially introduce her to his colleagues. He proposes to her after the match and both of their families start planning for their wedding.

episodes.title: The Dream Wedding
episodes.overview: Jing Jing wants Yu Tu to apply for the institute's group wedding instead of holding one on their own. Yu Tu doesn't agree at first but soon changes his mind after knowing Jing Jing's dream wedding. He makes a formal proposal and proceeds with the romantic group wedding.

episodes.title: Family Visit
episodes.overview: Yu Tu invites Jing Jing to the launch site. Jing Jing knows that Yu Tu doesn't have time for her, so she takes all the other family members of the staff to go sightseeing so that Yu Tu can focus at work. At night, Yu Tu tells Jing Jing about his next task after the launch.

episodes.title: Final Launch
episodes.overview: It is finally the day of the launch of God Finder. People from all over the country gather at the launch site at Wenchang to witness history. With immense tenacity and competence, Yu Tu leads his unit, and along with other units, they execute the mission perfectly.

series.title: Mouse (Mousetrap) [Hindi]
series.overview: A psychopath's ruthless serial murders have left the entire nation gripped by fear and chaos. An honest, justice-seeking rookie police officer and a veteran detective with a tragic past, face off against the killer. After their encounter with the psychopath, their lives change completely.

episodes.title: The Head Hunter
episodes.overview: Terrifying news of an unsolved serial killing case strikes the country, putting everyone in fear. One day, a family of four visits a camp site just to face a horrible death by this very serial killer, Head Hunter. A boy survives the ambush and later on pinpoints the prime suspect as the killer. Meanwhile, a gene test to verify an unborn fetus for its potential psychopathic characteristics is carried out on Head Hunter’s baby, and the baby’s mother has to make a choice.

episodes.title: Eye for an Eye
episodes.overview: Moo Chi visits the Head Hunter at the prison and tells him that he’ll not only kill the Head Hunter but find his son and make him suffer as he did. Meanwhile, more murder victims are found in a row and the culprit is leaving leads, asking to be noticed. When Ba Reum visits Moojin Prison, he sees the Head Hunter and also witnesses another murder case.

episodes.title: Resurfacing Murder Cases
episodes.overview: Chi Kook has been found at the prison with multiple stab marks all over his body along with a message written in blood. Not long after that, Chi Kook’s watch, a present gifted by Ba Reum and Dong Koo, was retrieved at the grape farm murder site, leading Ba Reum to join Moo Chi for the investigation. Meanwhile, Bong Yi’s grandmother stumbles upon something she should’ve never found out while working as a cleaning lady for Bong Yi’s settlement money.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.overview: After Bong Yi’s grandmother is murdered and a mysterious finger is found at a church, Moo Chi and his team start investigating more thoroughly. Moo Chi feels that something is suspicious about Doctor Sung Yo Han, but he can’t find any evidence yet. A boy suddenly gets kidnapped and Moo Chi gets a call from the kidnapper. He demands Moo Chi to find out the reason why the boy had to be kidnapped before a certain time. Will Moo Chi be able to save the kid?

episodes.title: The Live Broadcast
episodes.overview: An hour-long live broadcast goes on air in hopes to save Han Kook. But Ba Reum sets off to a discreet journey as the rest struggle hard to find out the predator’s motive of murder. During the live broadcast, endless tip-offs and reports from former victims of the predator flood into the broadcast station. The investigation seems to progress in a positive outlook as Moo Chi narrows down the suspects. Will they be able find the murderer in time?

episodes.title: The Donkey and the Goat
episodes.overview: After Moo Won is brutally murdered, Moo Chi gives up on everything and only keeps drinking. While Han Kook is still missing and his life is under threat, the police haven’t found any clues on the culprit. When Moo Chi gets back on his feet and starts investigating Bong Yi’s grandmother’s case, he finds out about Yo Han and his mother.

episodes.title: Memory Loss
episodes.overview: After getting a gunshot wound, Yo Han is in critical condition. Ba Reum gets brain surgery. But after receiving the brain surgery, he suffers from memory loss. After a year, Moo Chi is assigned to a new team that collects and organizes criminal evidence. Ba Reum starts to work for a small precinct. On his first day at work, he accidentally finds a dead body.

episodes.title: Ba-reum's Memories
episodes.overview: Ba Reum’s instinctive intuition helps Moo Chi get closer to the bottom of the mystery behind the knots. But he suffers from the random flashbacks that seem very unfamiliar. While investigating the suspects, Moo Chi and Ba Reum spot a man who stands out from the rest. On the other hand, Kang Duk Soo, who has been released from prison keeps trying to find out where Bong Yi lives.

episodes.title: Ba-reum's Brain
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finds out about a shocking story behind his brain surgery a year ago. He’s tormented by unwanted memories that keep haunting him. Detective Ko is furious at Han Seo Joon’s remark of being saved and being at peace after accepting Christ and decides to kill him himself.

episodes.title: Sung Yo-han in Me
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finds himself acting a lot more violent than before and realizes that it’s getting harder to control himself. He even gets the urge to kill someone. While Ba Reum is terrified that the Yo Han inside him might take him over completely, another murder case occurs that shows the MO of the previous murder cases. If Yo Han wasn’t the culprit of the serial murders, then is the piece of brain transplanted into Ba Reum’s head not of a psychopath?

episodes.title: Kill Him! Kill Her!
episodes.overview: Ba Reum keeps hearing Yo Han’s voice in his head telling him to kill people. The hallucination eventually made him murder Woo Hyung Chul. When he goes to the station to turn himself in, he finds out all the evidence related to his murder is gone, including Woo Hyung Chul’s body. Bong Yi runs into Kang Duk Soo, which makes her anxious. On a rainy day, Kang Duk Soo starts making a move again.

episodes.title: The Yo-han in Ba-reum
episodes.overview: After killing Kang Duk Soo, Ba Reum keeps a close eye on how the investigation rolls out. He tries to keep a foot ahead so his murder stays unveiled. Bong Yi on the other hand, thinks Moo Chi was the killer of Kang and keeps her mouth shut even when she’s being speculated as a suspect.

episodes.title: DNA on the Weapon
episodes.overview: The DNA result found on the weapon that was used to kill Kang Duk Soo confuses Moo Chi. Bong Yi joins Hong Ju’s team and starts investigating the Suseong serial murder case. With Ba Reum, Bong Yi begins to find the link between the Suseong serial murder cases and the Guryeong attempted murder case. At the same time, Moo Chi also looks into one of the inmates’ cases from Moojin Penitentiary.

episodes.title: The Cat Killer
episodes.overview: Ko Nam, a bright and insightful kid finds out about a cat killer around his neighborhood. One day, he promises to share his personal investigation with Bong Yi but unexpectedly goes through an accident. Ba Reum and Moo Chi dig deeper to find out who would’ve done such a heinous act to a little kid.

episodes.title: It Was All Me!
episodes.overview: Ba Reum starts to remember everything and is filled with guilt. When Ba Reum sees Han Kook’s mother desperately looking for her child even after a year, he decides to confess his crimes and clear Yo Han’s name. Meanwhile, Moo Chi notices that Chi Kook is lying and that he reacts strangely sensitive towards Ba Reum.

episodes.title: Was It Really Sung Yo-han?
episodes.overview: Chi Kook’s sudden death shocks everyone and Ba Reum tries to convince Chi Kook’s mom in requesting an autopsy. Meanwhile, Detective Ko starts to doubt that Sung Yo Han was the real killer. He starts to dig deeper into Song Soo Ho’s past.

episodes.title: The Guryeong Family Massacre
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finally remembers what exactly happened to his family. He tries to set a trap to catch the mysterious OZ, and he finds out a secret about Dr. Daniel Lee in the process. Meanwhile, Moo Chi finds the unregistered car the OZ, the murderer who killed Chi Kook, used.

episodes.title: Please, Give Me Some Time
episodes.overview: Moo Chi finds out that Ba Reum was the killer and ferociously charges after him at the station. Moo Chi also suspects Detective Lee being part of the OZ organization and tries to carry out an investigation on the two, but it’s not easy. As flustered as he is, Ba Reum tries to remain calm to buy time until he figures out the killer of Chi Kook.

episodes.title: Kim Joon-sung's Laptop
episodes.overview: Moo Chi and Bong Yi get closer to the truth. In the meantime, Ba Reum tries to find his aunt, the last missing puzzle piece. Sang, who tries to confirm Ba Reum’s alibi, finds something suspicious at Ba Reum’s house.

episodes.title: Ba-reum's Final Call
episodes.overview: Ba Reum makes the final decision to turn himself in and finish one last mission that only he can do. Hong Ju also shares her big secret that’s been tormenting her for years on her last show with Hee Jin, a woman who in fact was a secret agent working for Choi Young Shin under a massive private organization.

Moo Chi feels that something is suspicious about Doctor Sung Yo Han, but he can’t find any evidence yet. A boy suddenly gets kidnapped and Moo Chi gets a call from the kidnapper. He demands Moo Chi to find out the reason why the boy had to be kidnapped before a certain time. Will Moo Chi be able to save the kid?

episodes.title: The Live Broadcast
episodes.overview: An hour-long live broadcast goes on air in hopes to save Han Kook. But Ba Reum sets off to a discreet journey as the rest struggle hard to find out the predator’s motive of murder. During the live broadcast, endless tip-offs and reports from former victims of the predator flood into the broadcast station. The investigation seems to progress in a positive outlook as Moo Chi narrows down the suspects. Will they be able find the murderer in time?

episodes.title: The Donkey and the Goat
episodes.overview: After Moo Won is brutally murdered, Moo Chi gives up on everything and only keeps drinking. While Han Kook is still missing and his life is under threat, the police haven’t found any clues on the culprit. When Moo Chi gets back on his feet and starts investigating Bong Yi’s grandmother’s case, he finds out about Yo Han and his mother.

episodes.title: Memory Loss
episodes.overview: After getting a gunshot wound, Yo Han is in critical condition. Ba Reum gets brain surgery. But after receiving the brain surgery, he suffers from memory loss. After a year, Moo Chi is assigned to a new team that collects and organizes criminal evidence. Ba Reum starts to work for a small precinct. On his first day at work, he accidentally finds a dead body.

episodes.title: Ba-reum's Memories
episodes.overview: Ba Reum’s instinctive intuition helps Moo Chi get closer to the bottom of the mystery behind the knots. But he suffers from the random flashbacks that seem very unfamiliar. While investigating the suspects, Moo Chi and Ba Reum spot a man who stands out from the rest. On the other hand, Kang Duk Soo, who has been released from prison keeps trying to find out where Bong Yi lives.

episodes.title: Ba-reum's Brain
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finds out about a shocking story behind his brain surgery a year ago. He’s tormented by unwanted memories that keep haunting him. Detective Ko is furious at Han Seo Joon’s remark of being saved and being at peace after accepting Christ and decides to kill him himself.

episodes.title: Sung Yo-han in Me
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finds himself acting a lot more violent than before and realizes that it’s getting harder to control himself. He even gets the urge to kill someone. While Ba Reum is terrified that the Yo Han inside him might take him over completely, another murder case occurs that shows the MO of the previous murder cases. If Yo Han wasn’t the culprit of the serial murders, then is the piece of brain transplanted into Ba Reum’s head not of a psychopath?

episodes.title: Kill Him! Kill Her!
episodes.overview: Ba Reum keeps hearing Yo Han’s voice in his head telling him to kill people. The hallucination eventually made him murder Woo Hyung Chul. When he goes to the station to turn himself in, he finds out all the evidence related to his murder is gone, including Woo Hyung Chul’s body. Bong Yi runs into Kang Duk Soo, which makes her anxious. On a rainy day, Kang Duk Soo starts making a move again.

episodes.title: The Yo-han in Ba-reum
episodes.overview: After killing Kang Duk Soo, Ba Reum keeps a close eye on how the investigation rolls out. He tries to keep a foot ahead so his murder stays unveiled. Bong Yi on the other hand, thinks Moo Chi was the killer of Kang and keeps her mouth shut even when she’s being speculated as a suspect.

episodes.title: DNA on the Weapon
episodes.overview: The DNA result found on the weapon that was used to kill Kang Duk Soo confuses Moo Chi. Bong Yi joins Hong Ju’s team and starts investigating the Suseong serial murder case. With Ba Reum, Bong Yi begins to find the link between the Suseong serial murder cases and the Guryeong attempted murder case. At the same time, Moo Chi also looks into one of the inmates’ cases from Moojin Penitentiary.

episodes.title: The Cat Killer
episodes.overview: Ko Nam, a bright and insightful kid finds out about a cat killer around his neighborhood. One day, he promises to share his personal investigation with Bong Yi but unexpectedly goes through an accident. Ba Reum and Moo Chi dig deeper to find out who would’ve done such a heinous act to a little kid.

episodes.title: It Was All Me!
episodes.overview: Ba Reum starts to remember everything and is filled with guilt. When Ba Reum sees Han Kook’s mother desperately looking for her child even after a year, he decides to confess his crimes and clear Yo Han’s name. Meanwhile, Moo Chi notices that Chi Kook is lying and that he reacts strangely sensitive towards Ba Reum.

episodes.title: Was It Really Sung Yo-han?
episodes.overview: Chi Kook’s sudden death shocks everyone and Ba Reum tries to convince Chi Kook’s mom in requesting an autopsy. Meanwhile, Detective Ko starts to doubt that Sung Yo Han was the real killer. He starts to dig deeper into Song Soo Ho’s past.

episodes.title: The Guryeong Family Massacre
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finally remembers what exactly happened to his family. He tries to set a trap to catch the mysterious OZ, and he finds out a secret about Dr. Daniel Lee in the process. Meanwhile, Moo Chi finds the unregistered car the OZ, the murderer who killed Chi Kook, used.

episodes.title: Please, Give Me Some Time
episodes.overview: Moo Chi finds out that Ba Reum was the killer and ferociously charges after him at the station. Moo Chi also suspects Detective Lee being part of the OZ organization and tries to carry out an investigation on the two, but it’s not easy. As flustered as he is, Ba Reum tries to remain calm to buy time until he figures out the killer of Chi Kook.

episodes.title: Kim Joon-sung's Laptop
episodes.overview: Moo Chi and Bong Yi get closer to the truth. In the meantime, Ba Reum tries to find his aunt, the last missing puzzle piece. Sang, who tries to confirm Ba Reum’s alibi, finds something suspicious at Ba Reum’s house.

episodes.title: Ba-reum's Final Call
episodes.overview: Ba Reum makes the final decision to turn himself in and finish one last mission that only he can do. Hong Ju also shares her big secret that’s been tormenting her for years on her last show with Hee Jin, a woman who in fact was a secret agent working for Choi Young Shin under a massive private organization.

episodes.overview: Someone who knows the secret of time travel deliberately hid the camcorder. The twins’ investigation points to Hyeong-won.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The twins return to 2026, where Woo-jae has become an actor and turns his back on Ha-na. Meanwhile, Ha-na receives a mysterious screenplay.

series.title: Crash Landing on You [Hindi]
series.overview: A paragliding mishap drops a South Korean heiress in North Korea -- and into the life of an army officer, who decides he will help her hide.
series.description: A paragliding mishap drops a South Korean heiress in North Korea -- and into the life of an army officer, who decides he will help her hide.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Knocked out by fierce winds while paragliding through the air, Yun Se-ri wakes up on the north side of the Korean DMZ, where Ri Jeong Hyeok finds her.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After talking Jeong Hyeok and his comrades into hiding her in his home, Se-ri gets a taste of his way of life. Gu Seung-jun buys refuge in Pyongyang.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Jeong Hyeok invents a bold background story for Se-ri, but Cho Cheol Gang isn't so easy to fool. Seo Dan returns to North Korea.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: When her escape plan falls through, Se-ri turns to another idea for a way out. Dan heads to the village to see Jeong Hyeok.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jeong Hyeok agrees to marry Dan sooner, as his parents wish, but they must do him a favor first. Seung-jun catches a glimpse of Se-ri.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Dan is less than happy when she hears Jeong Hyeok and Se-ri are at a hotel together. Meanwhile, Seung-jun plays what cards he has to save himself.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A flight out of North Korea awaits Se-ri at the airport. But unwilling to leave Jeong Hyeok while he's injured, she brings him to the hospital instead.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Keeping Jeong Hyeok away from Se-ri turns out to be much more difficult than Seung-jun anticipated. Cheol Gang stays on their tail.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Se-ri faces her kidnapper. Elsewhere, Jeong Hyeok is forced to spread a formidable rumor about himself in order to escape Cheol Gang's clutches.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Back to her cushy life in the spotlight, Se-ri takes care of business — though nothing feels quite the same. Jeong Hyeok goes after Cheol Gang.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.overview: It's Jeong Hyeok's turn to adjust to a new world. Back in North Korea, Dan gives Seung-jun a place to stay after he loses his protection.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Hoping to meet Jeong Hyeok, his comrades attend an event hosted by Se-ri's company. Seung-jun opens up to Dan over a bowl of rice porridge.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Se-ri sends the comrades on a shopping spree, and plays hooky from work with Jeong Hyeok. Jung Man Bok encounters a dilemma.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.overview: While Jeong Hyeok keeps watch over Se-ri, his comrades make themselves useful. Seung-jun can't stop worrying about Dan.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.overview: South Korean officials try to figure out what's going on, but they're given conflicting stories. Seung-jun flees from his captors.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Before departing, Jeong Hyeok leaves behind a surprise that keeps on giving. Dan delivers bittersweet justice.

series.title: High School Return of a Gangster [Hindi]
series.overview: A spirit of a middle school dropout gangster who accidentally possesses an 18-year-old boy’s body who killed himself, goes back to high school to take a revenge against the bullies with his gangster skills and encounters unexpected relationship.
series.description: A spirit of a middle school dropout gangster who accidentally possesses an 18-year-old boy’s body who killed himself, goes back to high school to take a revenge against the bullies with his gangster skills and encounters unexpected relationship.

episodes.title: Deuk Pal Goes to High School
episodes.overview: Deuk Pal is about to become the boss of the Chilsung Gang. While mulling over giving up his dream of going to university, he tries to save Yi Heon from jumping off a bridge. Unfortunately, Deuk Pal loses his life but takes over Yi Heon's body. He learns of Yi Heon's misfortunes and resolves to avenge his suffering as a victim of bullying.

episodes.title: You Are Not Song Yi Heon
episodes.overview: Deuk Pal, now inhabiting Yi Heon’s body, arouses suspicion from Se Kyung due to his noticeable deviation from his usual self. Despite Deuk Pal's attempts to mimic Yi Heon's behaviour, the other kids begin to question the sudden change in him. Particularly with Jae Min persisting in ridiculing Yi Heon, Deuk Pal plots a subtle revenge for him.

episodes.title: Deuk Pal Takes Charge
episodes.overview: Deuk Pal proves he can fight in Yi Heon's body and gains control over Jae Min and his underlings. The kids at school can't believe how different Yi Heon is and are shocked. Se Kyung gets DNA testing done to see if Yi Heon is still the Yi Heon he knows, and Deuk Pal focuses on his studies and setting things right for Yi Heon. Meanwhile, Deuk Pal learns about what happened the night before Yi Heon died from Se Kyung as they become closer.

episodes.title: Yi Heon's Mom Kidnapping
episodes.overview: Deuk Pal and Se Kyung save Yi Heon's mom from getting kidnapped. Luckily, she was unharmed. Although he has a hunch about who might be responsible, Deuk Pal vows to protect Yi Heon and his family without the police involved. Meanwhile, Jae Min approaches Deuk Pal to find out if the police are looking for him, but Se Kyung confronts him about his involvement in the attempted kidnapping.

episodes.title: Yi Heon Warns Dong Soo
episodes.overview: Se Kyung witnesses Yi Heon getting abducted but can't do anything about it because he remembers Yi Heon telling him not to call the police about anything. He asks Jae Min for help, but Jae Min cowards out. Meanwhile, Yi Heon deals with the gangsters and tells them things that shock them.

episodes.title: Reach Out
episodes.overview: Deuk Pal and Se Kyung go to see the ocean and have a day off. Se Kyung talks about his father who’s been trying to control him since young and how it made him stressed and suffocating. Se Kyung’s father comes to school and calls for the violence committee. Meanwhile, Deuk Pal finds out that Yi Heon’s mother has been taking addictive medicine.

episodes.title: This Is Your Last Chance
episodes.overview: Deuk Pal found out that the school bullies reported Yi Heon for school violence. He orders Dong Soo and the gang to get Lee Mi Kyung since she is the one behind them. Byung Chul tells Jae Min to join him and report Yi Heon as well. Jae Min feels guilty about falsely charging Yi Heon, but he's also scared that he might end up going to the juvie if the truth is revealed.

episodes.title: Goodbye
episodes.overview: Jae Min confesses to bullying Yi Heon and other kids at school. Thanks to Jae Min, the charges are dropped, but Deuk Pal still needs to find Mi Kyung so that she won't come back to threaten Yi Heon and his mother again. He decides to meet Chairman Bae and set everything right. Meanwhile, Yi Heon's soul returns and tells Deuk Pal that he does not have much time left.

series.title: Love Next Door [Hindi]
series.overview: A woman attempting to reboot her life returns to Korea and becomes entangled with her childhood friend — with whom she shares a complicated history.
series.description: A woman attempting to reboot her life returns to Korea and becomes entangled with her childhood friend — with whom she shares a complicated history.

episodes.title: Comeback
episodes.overview: Soon-to-be-wed Bae Seok-ryu returns to Korea and runs into her old friend Choi Seung-hyo. But she acts strangely around him, hiding a secret.

episodes.title: Hate
episodes.overview: Even as her loved ones ask for an explanation, Seok-ryu hides her vulnerabilities until a confrontation with her mom forces Seung-hyo to come to her aid.

episodes.title: Stop Line
episodes.overview: As Seok-ryu adjusts to unemployment, she faces anxiety about her stagnant life. Seung-hyo clashes with his partner after a tense business meeting.

episodes.title: Past Perfect
episodes.overview: When Seok-ryu's old company presents a promising opportunity, she and Seung-hyo collaborate. Later, an unsettling encounter leaves Seok-ryu rattled.

episodes.title: Go Back
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo starts acting awkwardly around Seok-ryu as old feelings resurface. To complicate things further, he faces a delicate situation at work.

episodes.title: Your First
episodes.overview: Seok-ryu explores a new career path, tapping into a childhood passion. However, her family faces a crisis when her father's secret comes to light.

episodes.title: Love Is All About Timing
episodes.overview: A figure from Seok-ryu's past appears, leaving those around her looking for clarity — including Seung-hyo, who navigates his own complicated feelings.

episodes.title: His Secret
episodes.overview: As the truth finally comes out, Seung-hyo waits for Seok-ryu's response. Meanwhile, Seok-ryu's parents discover her new endeavor, sparking their fury.

episodes.title: Darkness in Life
episodes.overview: As Seok-ryu deals with an ailment, Seung-hyo and Song Hyeon-jun compete for her affection. But soon, Seung-hyo discovers the real reason for her return.

episodes.title: Bear in the Cave
episodes.overview: Seok-ryu's secret comes to light, leaving her loved ones struggling with the shock. When she goes missing, Seung-hyo desperately sets out to find her.

episodes.title: Belated
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo awaits Seok-ryu's genuine response as time passes since his confession. But suddenly, he receives a shocking announcement from his parents.

episodes.title: Puppy Love
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu try to navigate their relationship dynamic. Soon, feelings of jealousy arise, and they struggle to resolve a fight.

episodes.title: Love
episodes.overview: As their relationship blooms, Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu struggle to keep their status a secret. Jung Mo-eum finds out what's behind Kang Dan-ho's coldness.

episodes.title: Sweet Love
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo takes it into his own hands to encourage Seok-ryu's cooking ambitions. Convinced it's the right moment, he asks her an important question.

episodes.title: Bravo, My Life
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu face their parents' wrath after their secret is revealed — pushing the tension between their mothers to a boiling point.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu, happy in their relationship, prepare for a lifetime together. They inspire each other as they work toward their personal goals.

series.title: Sweet Home [Hindi]
series.overview: As humans turn into savage monsters and the world plunges into terror, a handful of survivors fight for their lives — and to hold on to their humanity.
series.description: As humans turn into savage monsters and the world plunges into terror, a handful of survivors fight for their lives — and to hold on to their humanity.
series.director: Lee Eung-bok, Jang Young-woo, Park So-hyun

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Cha Hyun-su moves into the run-down Green Home by himself. Not long after, he witnesses a disturbing sight in his neighbor's apartment.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As a state of emergency is declared, the residents tie up Pyeon Sang-wook for being bitten. Hyun-su is unable to ignore a family in distress.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: An unexpected savior protects the children from harm as Hyun-su, together with Yoon Ji-su and Jung Jae-heon, tries to bring them to safety.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Critical information about the monsters is made public. When residents are split on what to do with Hyun-su, Lee Eun-hyeok suggests they hold a vote.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Tasked to carry out dangerous missions, Hyun-su heads back to retrieve Han Du-sik. Sang-wook stops at nothing to finish what he started.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: An Seon-yeong confronts the greatest monster in her life. Leaving the building, Seo Yi-kyung heads to her fiancé's office in search of answers.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hyun-su saves the others from a deadly attack. Running out of necessities, Eun-hyeok announces a plan to venture outside for resources.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Having little options in her state of being, Ji-su agrees to take a big risk. Yi-kyung returns to Green Home just in time.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: When a team of outlaws take over the building, the residents are shown how humans can be even more barbaric than the monsters.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: A military leaflet promises a route to safety, but the group is reluctant to trust it. Hyun-su is exposed to a new perspective on his condition.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hyun-su wakes up to find Sang-wook, who has a new goal for them. Lee Eun-yu and Ji-su escape a violent evacuation and commandeer their next destination.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Eun-yu finds a hint of Eun-hyeok’s fate at a stop in her journey. During an experiment, Hyun-su finds that he has a special effect on another monster.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: On a mission to find her husband, Yi-kyung makes a shocking discovery. The battered Ji-su and Eun-yu arrive at a new shelter, but catastrophe awaits them.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The survivors take shelter underground, where supplies run low. In her continued search for Eun-hyeok, Eun-yu encounters a young girl.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Sergeant Kim and Master Sergeant Tak clash on how to protect their men. The mysterious girl approaches Eun-yu with an enticing offer.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Eun-yu chases Yi-kyung and the girl, with Park Chan-yeong right behind her. The death of survivors and a missing soldier throws the stadium into unrest.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Eun-yu shares a terse reunion with Hyun-su. While the platoon embarks on their search for a missing soldier, the stadium experiences a monster threat.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: As Yi-kyung faces death, the young girl tries to save her. In the ruins of the lab, the soldiers discover other survivors who aren't what they seem.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hyun-su gives it his all to bring Yi-kyung’s humanity back. Sergeant Kim faces countless monsters in an effort to make it out alive with his men.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Resolved to find his child, Jung Ui-myeong heads to the stadium. Despite Hyun-su's unpredictability, Eun-yu tries to wake him up during a sudden crisis.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Yi-kyung discovers Ui-myeong's true motive for him and their daughter. Eun-yu accepts a challenge from Hyun-su's alter ego and heads to the stadium.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The girl contemplates her future with Yi-kyung — and a life away from Ui-myeong. Sergeant Kim encounters Eun-hyeok, who reveals a new kind of being.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Eun-hyeok's reunion with Hyun-su and Eun-yu turns into chaos. Ui-myeong prepares for his body transfer, while Sergeant Tak carries out his own plan.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: In her trek to the stadium, Eun-yu begins to feel a personal worry. While Ui-myeong searches for the girl, she plans a counterattack in the background.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hyun-su and Eun-hyeok arrive at the stadium, splitting up to find Ui-myeong. During the great escape, Sergeant Tak commits the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: In the final battle, Hyun-su and Eun-hyeok confront the girl head-on — getting an assist from an old friend. Will they finally succeed?

series.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

episodes.title: Illiterate Goldy
episodes.overview: Headmaster Gyaneshwar Tripathi can go to the UK if the Class 10 students ace the board exams. The only problem is that the students don't attend school. Meanwhile, the idealistic Kanchan arrives to fix a system that resists change.

episodes.title: Ideal Role Model
episodes.overview: As Gyaneshwar searches for the perfect role model to motivate clueless students, Kanchan plays detective over a missing confiscated watch.

episodes.title: Teacher's Tribute

series.description: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: After a fatal shooting, Green Lantern Hal Jordan and new recruit John Stewart set out to prove it was an extraterrestrial event.

episodes.title: Trust Fall
episodes.overview: While John's middling errand ultimately proves eventful, Hal makes waves in Rushville – which only inspires him to dig deeper.

episodes.title: OutKast
episodes.overview: When his dad misunderstands a contact attempt from the Guardians, John is put forth as the next best option to fulfill the Green Lantern destiny. Then, after a lifetime of preparation, John finally gets his chance to interview for the Guardians.

episodes.title: The Weenie
episodes.overview: As the 48-hour deadline nears, John develops a new theory about the Manhunter's location, leading him and Hal to run their next move by Sheriff Kane. Meanwhile, Hal's visit to Sinestro has consequences.

episodes.title: Lights Out
episodes.overview: As the Macon family's history unravels, Rushville mobilizes in the face of the escalating threat. As John is placed in an impossible position, Hal risks everything in a final attempt to take down the Manhunter.

episodes.title: Bad Optics
episodes.overview: Now in business with his brother Marcus, John is on the verge of landing a major investor for his innovative take on panic rooms when an unexpected phone call pulls him back to Rushville - and everything he worked so hard to leave behind.

episodes.title: The Jordan Boys' Legacy
episodes.overview: Finding themselves on another planet, Hal and John must put aside their fractured past to solve a murder. Along their journey, both men are forced to confront the ghosts of their pasts...and the ways their childhoods shaped who they are today.

episodes.title: Dirt and Stars
episodes.overview: As John and Hal draw closer to the truth, John comes to an unexpected understanding with Sheriff Kane... just as a chilling new discovery emerges.

series.title: Tale of the Nine Tailed [Hindi]
series.overview: A TV producer discovers a secret supernatural world as she becomes entangled with a former deity who's spent centuries searching for his lost lover.

episodes.title: The Incident That Occurred on Yeou Gogae
episodes.overview: Ji-ah who lost her parents in a freakish car accident on Yeougogae when she was 9 years old, becomes a producer of  the investigative program called "Finding Local Myths". One day, she receives a report on a suspicious "monster".

episodes.title: I've Been Waiting for You
episodes.overview: Ji-ah finally meets a mysterious creature she had been looking for and she thinks Lee Yeon is the last evidence to find her long-lost parents. However, Lee Yeon draws a line to Ji-ah. Then, they both get caught up in a shocking incident.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Dragon King
episodes.overview: On the suspicious Eohwa Island, Ji-ah finds the evidence of head incident along with her parents' story. However, while investigating on the incident, she falls into danger with Lee Rang's appearance.

episodes.title: Verge of Death
episodes.overview: After returning from the island, Lee Yeon falls into Ji-ah when he knows she's not the one he has been looking for. Even Ji-ah also is attracted to Yeon gradually.  After a short date, Lee Yeon is given a serious trial.

episodes.title: I Also Waited for You
episodes.overview: Lee Yeon finally has assured that A-eum reincarnated as Ji-ah. However, he hides it from Ji-ah as he wants her to live a normal life. Then, he begins to search Ji-ah's parents and goes to 'Satto' who has the information on Ji-ah's parents.

episodes.title: Four Pillars of Destiny
episodes.overview: Ji-ah and Yeon finally meet "Satto", but he refuses to give information. Meanwhile, Rang also visits Korean Folk Village to find an item. Then, he makes a risky deal on Yeon.

episodes.title: The Trap of Samsara
episodes.overview: The incarnated Imoogi moves towards Ji-ah and Yeon. Yeon barges into Ji-ah's house to protect her. Then, Yeon's brutal truth behind his past gets revealed.

episodes.title: Reincarnation
episodes.overview: Ji-ah is shocked that Yeon is the one who killed her in the past. Then, they move away from one another for each other. However, she decides to find out about the truth. Then, they fall into the Imoogi's trap.

episodes.title: Spirit of Darkness
episodes.overview: Yeon and Rang trapped in the Forest of evil. They fight against those evil sprits endlessly. After reuniting her long missed parents, she refueses to go back to her life.

episodes.title: Déjà Vu
episodes.overview: Ji-ah and Yeon finally face the truth of the past. They promise to look only at each other's present and stay together no matter what happens. Then, Yeon goes to save Rang who is in danger.

episodes.title: Ground Cherries
episodes.overview: The Butler uses Ji-ah's parents as a bait to threaten Ji-ah for Yeon's body. Then, the Imoogi declares to Yeon that he will own Ji-ah. Rang is threatened with his life at stake.

episodes.title: Catch the Tail
episodes.overview: Ji-ah finally meets her parents after 21 years. However, Rang faces a new challenge as soon as released from the contract and goes out to find Imoogi and Yeon to protect his precious people.

episodes.title: The Other Imoogi
episodes.overview: Another Imoogi within Ji-ah came out. Ji-ah and Yeon spend a mournful night before the sad fate ahead of them. The pandemic Imoogi caused puts the human world in chaos. Yeon and reborn Rang carry out a plan to bring an end to the endless fight.

episodes.title: Dead End
episodes.overview: Taluipa sentence Ji-ah to death and turns down Yeon, who wants to catch Imoogi after figuring out how Imoogi switches to another body. Yeon now makes his final choice in the face of ever-changing fate.

episodes.title: Without Knowing Imoogi's Plan
episodes.overview: Ji-ah and Yeon have their final date, hiding their feelings for each other. A faint hope appears before them, but it shatters because of an evil scheme Imoogi plots.

episodes.title: The Rewritten Tale of the Nine Tailed
episodes.overview: Left behind in the world without Yeon, Ji-ah visits the Afterlife Immigration Office and begs for Yeon's return. However, there seems no way. In April, when the snow falls, an especial person appears.

episodes.title: Chapter 1: Brotherhood, 1938
episodes.overview: Four months after Lee Rang’s death, Lee Yeon resumes to be the nine-tailed fox on the condition that Lee Rang reincarnates. Meanwhile, an uninvited guest steals the guardian stone, and disappears "into the cabinet." Lee Yeon jumps into the cabinet and finds himself standing in Gyeongseong in the year 1938. He then encounters Lee Rang, who immediately just charges at his brother, yelling "Die!"

episodes.title: Chapter 2: Beautiful "Mi"
episodes.overview: After saving Lee Rang, Lee Yeon fails to return to the present, so he visits Taluipa of the 1930s, who asks him to work for her until the Gate of Time reopens. Under Taluipa's orders, both brothers board a train to find the Legendary Pipe. Inside the train is a woman who prepares to greet Lee Yeon, Shinju who devises an escape plan, and an hourglass that indicates the approaching overpass.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: Saetani
episodes.overview: There's a "big rice chest" covered with amulets, and Moo-yeong appears before it. He is then seen carrying a blindfolded young girl, who removes her blindfold and chimes her bell saying, "Where are you? Found you!" Lee Yeon opens his eyes and meets her gaze, only to wake up screaming. That afternoon, after seeing Hong-joo holding a bouquet of flowers, everything goes black before his eyes...

episodes.title: Chapter 4: The Foundling (1)
episodes.overview: A strange basket appears in front of Myoyeongak. Inside it is a living, breathing baby with "7 red moles" on her forehead. Although both brothers secretly attempt to place the basket on someone else's doorstep, they return to find it sitting right where it was found?! Meanwhile, red-white mask steals from Gyeongseong’s gold mining royalties in search of the "golden ruler" that revives the dead.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: The Foundling (2)
episodes.overview: Inside Myoyeongak, detectives, who're here for baby, are confronting Lee Yeon and Lee Rang. A scuffle breaks out, while Mi-ho innocently smiles within the bubbles. Meanwhile, Hong-joo arrives in Manchuria where she finds "Lee Yeon in 1938" drunk on opium. Lee Yeon calls for "Ah-eum," to which her face turns cold. Just as she turns to leave, Lee Yeon from 1938 calls out and hugs her from behind...!

episodes.title: Chapter 6: The Corner Game
episodes.overview: A "red pouch" is placed on Myoyeongak's roof: Moo-yeong's invitation to a dangerous guest. Meanwhile, Jook-hyang notices one new gisaeng wearing a pair of "old straw shoes." That night, Eun-ho and the gisaengs play the "corner game" calling on corner ghosts. Just then, the candle burns out, and Eun-ho disappears. To get her back, the mountain gods and Shin-ju play the corner game once again...

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Jangsan Tiger
episodes.overview: Lee Yeon and Moo-young get caught in an unknown act while searching for the Jangsan Tiger in the "Path of the Damned." They're tied up and had their throats slashed mercilessly, only to wake up and find that it was all for a TV series set. They are given a script titled "Jangsan Tiger's Bride." As they attempt to leave, they're surprised to see the female lead get out of a van. It's Hong-joo.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: Indigenous Gods
episodes.overview: It's been days since Jangsan Tiger's uproar. Lee Rang remembers Moo-yeong's warning and heads to Myoyeongak. "Shinigami Mercenaries" arrive at Gyeongseong Station, and are ordered to capture "Joseon demons." Meanwhile, protesting indigenous gods go to Myoyeonggak. Hyunuiong looks troubled. Lee Rang changes his expression during a gambling event where the bet is on lifespan instead of money.

episodes.title: Chapter 9: Bando Hotel
episodes.overview: Gyeongseong's indigenous gods vanished and died overnight! At Myoyeongak, Lee Yeon tells Hong-joo that he will take the treasures to the Bando Hotel. After a round of fist fights and drinks, Lee Yeon tells Moo-yeong the same thing. Meanwhile, Hong-joo bargains with the Chief Commissioner for the safety of Myoyeongak and her girls... All demons gather at the Bando Hotel to obtain the treasures.

episodes.title: Chapter 10: Shinigami Mercenaries
episodes.overview: In the painting at Bando Hotel, Room 404, the three mountain gods face Ushiuchibo. At the snap of his finger, Hong-joo and Moo-yeong vomit blood. Lee Yeon searches for an antidote in the woods when he encounters an injured old man. The old man turns out to be Onyudo, a mercenary. As black smoke emerges from his mouth, something unbelievable happens. They switch bodies!

episodes.title: Chapter 11: Trap
episodes.overview: Lee Yeon as Nyudo appears astounded that there are five mercenaries, not four. As he unwraps a piece of caramel, he calls for Oogama and Yuki to buy some time. Nyudo as Lee Yeon lures Hong-joo and Moo-yeong, and the guardian stone's whereabouts provoke them to fight. Meanwhile, Yeo-hee's breathing unstabilizes and axiousness permeates Room 302. Azalea determinedly approaches with a dagger...

episodes.title: Chapter 12: Joseon's Last Mountain God
episodes.overview: In a room filled with opium smoke, Lee Yeon from 1938 starts after reading a letter. Yeo-hee and Jae-yoo got kidnapped last night. Lee Yeon meets the Chief Commissioner who proposes an exchange deal. Akira informs Hong-joo and Lee Rang that the one hostage who gets to live depends on them. The air is tense as Lee Rang's eyes shake at Hong-joo's words. That's when Lee Yeon bursts into the room...

series.title: Island [Hindi]
series.overview: Evil took its first step to destroy the world. On the mysterious island of Jeju Island, the gateway to this, "Van," a mix of human and monster, "Won Mi-ho," the one in the center of fate, and "Johan," the one who exercises God’s power, come together. A strange, yet captivating, action-packed exorcism fantasy in which they fight evil, share the fate of saving the world, and defy their own...

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Won Mi-ho is the only heiress to the Daehan Group. She falls for her aunt’s plot and becomes the center of a controversy after beating up a person in the middle of the city. Mi-ho is sent to Jeju Island until things quiet down, but she comes across a lust demon in a wedding dress.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Not only was Mi-ho chased twice by lust demons, but the police are now also treating her like a drug user. She is trying to come up with a plan to escape Jeju Island and go back to Seoul. But before she could get on a plane, she ended up in a life-threatening car chase with a lust demon.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Johan moves into Mi-ho’s villa to live with Van and Mi-ho, disguised as Butler Jang’s nephew. Mi-ho is displeased with Van, who doesn’t seem to cooperate and can’t even drive a car. On top of that, Johan starts tagging along to school.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Mi-ho meets the last of Benjulle’s trees after a fierce battle in Benjulle’s forest. Mi-ho returns to her villa after saving Su-ryeon and starts planning on how to punish Gyeong-jun. Meanwhile, Johan provokes Van to find out his identity, summoning the hidden nature of the lust demon. Mi-ho comes to look for Van and Johan and sees Van transforming into a lust demon.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Van feels guilty for nearly killing Mi-ho and disappears into the darkness. To find Van, Mi-ho goes through rough mountain tracks to Taejangsa Temple, only to walk away after being hurt by his coldness. Meanwhile, the number of mysterious murder cases where the organs were extracted from the victims is increasing all over Jeju Island.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Johan brings Chan-hee to the villa. They spend time happily together, promising each other that they would not part again. However, Chan-hee has already turned into a lust demon, and he leaves Johan’s room to go after Mi-ho’s life. After finding out about the secret of reincarnation, Mi-ho visits and asks Geum Baek-ju to help her become Wonjeong.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Long ago, Jeju was thrown into confusion by an outbreak of lust demons. Wonjeong, fated to save the island by establishing the Barrier, secretly visits and forms a friendship with two boys, Van and Gungtan, who were raised solely to kill lust demons. Ten years later, Wonjeong returns to Taejangsa Temple after completing her training to establish the Barrier.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Johan overcomes his despair after Chan-hee's death. Mi-ho, who is in pain and blaming herself, vows not to lose anyone else who is precious. From then, she begins receiving intense training from Geum Baek-ju at Granny Haenyeo's Home to regain the power of Wonjeong. Johan and Van follow Mi-ho but observe from a distance so that they don't interrupt her energy.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Gungtan remembers once again that Wonjeong had sealed him in the past and escapes without being able to harm Mi-ho. Captivated by fear and anger, Gungtan begins to plunge the world into darkness. Mi-ho starts to blame herself, believing that the tragedy will only end when she dies.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Mi-ho finds out about Butler Chang's secret and tries to kill herself as she feels betrayed. The moment Van rushes to Mi-ho and holds her hand, she recovers all the memories from the past. Gungtan rages as he feels dejected after watching Mi-ho fail to regain power even after her memory has returned.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Van learns that Mi-ho will vanish if she regains the power, leaving only Wonjeong. After agonizing, Van tries to stop Mi-ho’s training to become Wonjeong. Mi-ho is just frustrated and upset at Van’s sudden behavior.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.overview: It's finally the day to establish the Barrier. Mi-ho, on her way to the altar, fights a great battle against lust demons alongside Butler Chang, who has returned, and Johan, who woke up from a coma. After defeating countless lust demons, Mi-ho leaves the rest to Van, Johan, and Butler Chang and goes up to the altar.

series.title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier [Hindi]
series.overview: A plastic-spoon man is on his way to becoming a legendary army cook—uncovering dark secrets within the base through his cooking skills.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Kang Seong-jae enlists in the army as a cook and receives mysterious game-like commands that appear only to him.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Facing reassignment, Seong-jae must complete a high-stakes cooking quest within 72 hours to secure his role as military cook.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Seong-jae must improvise a daring dish during a surprise inspection to save his military kitchen.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Seong-jae's culinary success lifts unit morale but triggers professional jealousy and tension after an unexpected encounter.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Stripped of his skills while on leave, Seong-jae works as a kitchen assistant to save his mother's business and discovers a secret ingredient.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Seong-jae rallies the troops with an improvised arancini, but encounters danger after overhearing Captain Lee's plot.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A quest challenges Seong-jae to turn his rival, Sergeant Kim Kwan-cheol, into an ally.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Seong-jae navigates rising tensions and a sudden offer to join the officer's mess.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Seong-jae enters the officer's mess and completes a crucial quest.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Seong-jae begins his final quest and participates in a cooking competition.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Seong-jae teams up with Sergeant Yoon and Sergeant Kim, as they go head-to-head with Lee Ho-young.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.overview: As Seong-jae emerges as the contest winner, a brand new quest comes to light, challenging his skills once again.

series.title: Sins of Kujo (2026) [Hindi]
series.description: From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

episodes.title: Episode 1 - The Worth of a Leg
episodes.overview: At Kujo Law Office, an eccentric attorney takes on a hit-and-run case as a favor to gang leader Mibu — raising questions from his curious new partner.

episodes.title: Episode 2 - The Dignity of the Vulnerable
episodes.overview: A flashback reveals a past connection between the two lawyers. Kujo proposes a risky strategy that gives a client confidence to break his negative cycle.

episodes.title: Episode 3 - The Dignity of the Vulnerable 2
episodes.overview: Sogabe makes a firm decision to break his situation — and goes to prison. After a run-in with his estranged brother, Kujo meets with a suspicious CEO.

episodes.title: Episode 4 - Family Ties
episodes.overview: A disturbing case of fraud and coercion at a nursing home leads Kujo to confront his former mentor, Yamashiro, in a bid to stop his reckless actions.

episodes.title: Episode 5 - Family Ties 2
episodes.overview: Kujo takes on a new request where a past conflict between Mibu and his boss Kyogoku, the young leader of the Kyogoku gang, comes to light.

episodes.title: Episode 6 - Remnants of Consumption
episodes.overview: Kujo agrees to defend Kyogoku's associate in a case fronted by his former classmate. Meanwhile, a troubled girl tries to enter the adult video industry.

episodes.title: Episode 7 - Remnants of Consumption 2
episodes.overview: After her parents' selfish actions, Shizuku turns to Shuto for support but instead finds more manipulation, pushing her to the edge as tragedy strikes.

episodes.title: Episode 8 - The Undetected Truth
episodes.overview: Karasuma presses Mibu about his connection to Detective Arashiyama's case and goes out of his way to protect Kujo from any further involvement.

episodes.title: Episode 9 - The Undetected Truth 2
episodes.overview: After Arashiyama questions Koyama about a past murder case, Kujo comes under fire from the detective who threatens to take him down, along with Mibu.

episodes.title: Episode 10 - Chain of Violence
episodes.overview: Karasuma and Kujo contemplate their partnership as their future hangs in the balance. Inukai's actions draw Mibu and Kyogoku into a risky situation.

series.title: Viral Hit (2026) [Hindi]
series.genre: Drama, Action, Martial Arts, High School
series.description: A bullied high schooler becomes an overnight sensation after a viral video. But when his newfound fame turns sour, he must learn to fight for himself.

episodes.title: Episode 1 - Do You Want to Become Stronger?
episodes.overview: Shimura endures daily torment from school tyrant Hamaken. But his luck changes when a scuffle with bootlicker Kanegon accidentally goes live — and viral.

episodes.title: Episode 2 - Fan the Flames of Anger
episodes.overview: Mugged by delinquents, Shimura follows TOU-KEI's teachings to fight back. Later, despite landing a blow on Hamaken, Shimura lands in even deeper trouble.

episodes.title: Episode 3 - I'm Not a Loser!
episodes.overview: Humiliated in front of his crush, Shimura disappears. As everyone searches desperately for him, Kanegon endures brutal violence from Hamaken.

episodes.title: Episode 4 - Well Then, My Friend
episodes.overview: Viral Hit faces its first crisis and Shimura must take on multiple opponents. Later, ex-taekwondo champ Shinjo targets them and attacks Kanegon.

episodes.title: Episode 5 - The Original Viral Hit
episodes.overview: The Shimura vs. Shinjo fight reaches a shocking conclusion. Viral Hit reaches 1M subscribers, and the head of BAD FELLOWS approaches with a proposition.

episodes.title: Episode 6 - This is My Youth
episodes.overview: As the final battle nears, Shimura's group face mounting challenges. TOU-KEI's secret emerges and their last fight begins — for friends, family and love.

Serkan Bolat offers Eda to give her scholarship back if she pretends to be his fiance for two months. Although Eda rejects the offer of this man as she hates him, she has to accept it when the conditions change. While pretending to be engaged, Serkan and Eda begin to experience a passionate, challenging relationship that will make them forget all they know right.

series.title: Love in Disguise [Hindi]
series.description: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

series.title: Make Me Tingle [Hindi]
series.description: A marketer with traditional views on love and marriage tries to navigate a connection with an adult toy company CEO with different values.

series.title: Take Charge of My Heart [Hindi]
series.description: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

series.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life [Hindi]
series.originalTitle: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life [Hindi]
series.description: Rein spent years enhancing his guildmates’ gear with magic, only to be expelled the moment he enchanted everything. Unfazed, Rein steals back his magic, pours it into his own sword, and makes the best of his newfound freedom as he sets off as an adventurer. Along the way, Rein gathers a band of fellow outcasts and together they fight monsters and carve out their place in an enchanted world.

series.title: Carrie [Hindi]
series.description: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

series.title: Overgeared [Hindi]
series.description: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

series.title: A Love Other Than Yours [Hindi]
series.description: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

series.title: Ali Baba aur 40 Bhoot [Hindi]
series.description: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

series.title: The Ordinary Jackpot [Hindi]
series.description: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

series.title: The Early Spring [Hindi]
series.description: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

series.title: Our Sticky Love [Hindi]
series.description: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

series.title: My Bias, My Boss [Hindi]
series.description: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

series.title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand [Hindi]
series.originalTitle: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand [Hindi]
series.description: Luck, an S-rank mage in the hero's party, makes a last stand against the Demon King to save his companions. When he finally returns victorious, ten years have passed, and the world praises him as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to reclaim his former life, Luck conceals his identity and begins again as "Lock," an F-rank adventurer forging a future in a world that moved on without him.

series.title: BLACK TORCH [Hindi]
series.description: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago’s powers.

series.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System [Hindi]
series.originalTitle: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System [Hindi]
series.description: Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn's future shatters when he awakens the so-called "defective" Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the "weakest" class.

series.title: Filing for Love [Hindi]
series.description: A romantic comedy about Joo In-ah, a charismatic audit department head with a secret, and Noh Ki-joon, the department's ace who is suddenly demoted to deal with the company's scandals.

series.title: The Ramparts of Ice [Hindi]
series.description: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

series.title: Arafta [Hindi]
series.description: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart.

series.title: Dhootha [Hindi]
series.description: Journalist Sagar's life turns thrilling as he unravels dark secrets behind newspaper clippings predicting tragedies. He becomes a murder suspect, racing against time to clear his name and solve the enigma and faces dangerous twists. Suspense builds in this roller-coaster ride.

episodes.title: Episode 1 - The Puzzle
episodes.overview: When Sagar the Chief Editor of ‘Samacharam’ newspaper, finds a crossword puzzle in a dhaba. The puzzle predicts a terrifying incident that would occur in his life.

episodes.title: Episode 2 - Editorial Cartoon
episodes.overview: Police Detective Kranthi Shenoy is given the suicide case of a popular journalist. While investigating she suspects foul play. Ajay Ghosh under Sagar’s instruction, interrogates Koti which leads to more problems.

episodes.title: Episode 3 - Horoscope
episodes.overview: Suicide investigation leads Kranthi to gun smuggling racket which eventually leads to the disappearance of Koti. Koti’s truck being involved in the accident, brings Sagar and Ajay Ghosh into the investigation’s purview. During the launch of ‘Samacharam’s’ first copy, Sagar receives a mysterious message in the form of old newspaper scrap.

episodes.title: Episode 4 - Crime Report
episodes.overview: While Sagar and Ajay Ghosh discuss recent events, they find a clue from the old newspaper scrap which drives their investigation further. Kranti and Ranga discover a connection between the case and Sagar’s farm house. The suspense continues to build.

episodes.title: Episode 5 - Page 3
episodes.overview: As Kranthi and Ranga continue the investigations they find an unexpected dead body. Sagar follows Kiran Reddy, the research head and host for the YouTube show "Ghost Shadows," and learns about Ravi’s research into journalist’s suicide. Sagar gets a newspaper scrap with yet another ominous prediction.

episodes.title: Episode 6 - This Day, That Year
episodes.overview: As Kranthi’s investigative net tightens around Sagar, he decides to visit Dhootha Publications in an attempt to unravel the mystery behind Sathyamurthy’s book. The story delves into a shocking past. With this information Sagar goes to the light house, closing in on the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 7 - Continued on Page 6
episodes.overview: As deaths continue, Sagar is forewarned about an impending danger to his family, he comes clean to Kranthi and together they race against time to stop the newspapers’ deadly prediction.

episodes.title: Episode 8 - Headlines
episodes.overview: Priya becomes the target of a mysterious killer. As the events unfold, Sagar’s past and family secrets comes to light, Kranti begins to connect the dots to uncover the truth.

series.title: The Terminal List [Hindi]
series.description: Navy SEAL Commander James Reece turns to vengeance as he investigates the mysterious forces behind the murder of his entire platoon. Free from the military's command structure, Reece applies the lessons he's learned from nearly two decades of warfare to hunt down the people responsible.

series.title: Karma [Hindi]
series.description: The stories of Amy, Ndeye Marie, Majib, and Maï are intertwined in a web of intrigue, drama, betrayal, and love. Between painful memories, the weight of the past, and youthful mistakes, one thing is certain: no one escapes Karma...

series.title: Kuruluş: Osman (Establishment: Osman) [Urdu]
series.description: The epic continuation of Diriliş Ertuğrul, Kuruluş Osman follows Osman Bey — son of Ertuğrul and destined founder of the Ottoman Empire — as he transforms a small Turkic tribe into a sovereign state. Battling the Byzantine Empire, Mongol forces and treachery from within, Osman must prove himself as both a warrior and a leader. A sweeping historical action drama built on faith, honour and the birth of one of history's greatest empires.

series.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun [Hindi]
series.description: Fourteen-year-old Iruma Suzuki has just been abandoned and sold to a demon by his irresponsible parents! Surprisingly, the next thing he knows he's living with the demon who has adopted him as his new grandson and has been transferred into a school in the Netherworld where his new demon grandfather works as the principal. Thus begins the cowardly Iruma-kun's extraordinary school life among the otherworldly as he faces his true self, takes on challenges, and rises to become someone great.

series.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest [Hindi]
series.originalTitle: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest [Hindi]
series.description: Hajime Nagumo and his high school class are suddenly summoned to a fantastical land as heroes. But while most of his classmates have powerful stats and abilities, Hajime does not. Underappreciated and unprepared, he tumbles into the depths of a monster-infested dungeon where voracity and sacrifice are his only options. To thrive in this savage world, he’ll have no choice but to welcome the abyss.

series.title: Hercai (Inconstant Love) [Hindi]
series.description: Miran is seeking revenge for his parents death so he plans to marry daughter Reyyan from the family who were responsible for that. Unexpectedly he falls in love with Reyyan. Will this change the plan?

series.title: A Korean Odyssey [Hindi]
series.description: A self-serving mythical creature's bid for invincibility backfires when he finds himself at the mercy of a woman who can see otherworldly beings.

series.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [Hindi]
series.originalTitle: Re: Zero, Starting Life in Another World [Hindi]
series.description: Natsuki Subaru, an ordinary high school  student, is on his way home from the convenience store when he finds  himself transported to another world. As he's lost and confused in a new  world where he doesn't even know left from right, the only person to  reach out to him was a beautiful girl with silver hair. Determined to  repay her somehow for saving him from his own despair, Subaru agrees to  help the girl find something she's looking for.

series.title: KONOSUBA - God's blessing on this wonderful world! [Hindi]
series.originalTitle: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! [Hindi]
series.description: After a traffic accident, Kazuma Sato’s  disappointingly brief life was supposed to be over, but he wakes up to  see a beautiful girl before him. She claims to be a goddess, Aqua, and  asks if he would like to go to another world and bring only one thing  with him. Kazuma decides to bring the goddess herself, and they are  transported to a fantasy world filled with adventure, ruled by a demon  king. Now Kazuma only wants to live in peace, but Aqua wants to solve  many of this world’s problems, and the demon king will only turn a blind  eye for so long…

series.title: Reply 1988 [Hindi]
series.description: Take a nostalgic trip back to the late 1980s through the lives of five families and their five teenage kids living in a small neighbourhood in Seoul.
